glosses: Revered in a religion.

examples.text: This tree is considered holy in my culture.

glosses: Morally perfect or flawless, or nearly so.

examples.text: My grandmother is a very holy woman.

glosses: Separated or set apart from (something unto something or someone else).
Set apart or dedicated for a specific purpose, or for use by a single entity or person.

examples.text: Holy cow, I can’t believe he actually lost the race!

glosses: An expression of astonishment and awe.

glosses: Having divine aid, or protection, or other blessing.

examples.text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

glosses: A title indicating the beatification of a person, thus allowing public veneration of those who have lived in sanctity or died as martyrs.
